ùm metus & periculum ab armis Hol-

page.notes: The leftmost opening letter is a fragment ("ficus"), probably the end of "Fridericus" continued from the previous page; read as printed with [?] not added because the scan is clear enough. The marginal date notes are printed with partial Roman numerals and may need checking: "Anno M ccc. xcix," and "Anno M cccc I". The line "Inter caufas" is followed by the catchword "alias". The text in the lower left, near the signature, is partly smudged. The scan shows show-through and a digitiser mark at the bottom right, which are left out.
